sentences.text: Shri Ankit Saxena - Advocate for the applicant.

Shri Shailendra Mishra - Dy. G.A. for the respondent/State
 Order

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C./482 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 seeking anticipatory bail in connection with FIR/Crime No.335/2024 dated 10.10.2024 registered at Police Station Jahangirabad, District Bhopal for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n) and 294 of IPC.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant contends that the present applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is contended by the counsel that the complainant is a major as well as married lady.

It is further contended by the counsel that the complainant has dispute with her husband and matrimonial disputes are going on between them, details of which, have already been brought on record as Annexure A/2, therefore, the allegations pertaining to refusal to enter into wedlock, are ill-founded and unsustainable.
As per the First Information Report, the complainant and the present applicant were in relationship since 31.12.2022, therefore, apparently, it's a case of consent.
No custodial interrogation is required in this matter.
There is no probability of his absconding or tampering with the evidence of prosecution.
Therefore, prays for grant of anticipatory bail to NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:55386 2 MCRC-48035-2024 the applicant.

3. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that taking into consideration the role played by the present applicant, the present application deserves to be Abhinav Mishra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103970495/
1 dismissed.
4.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard the rival submissions and perused the case diary.

5. A perusal of the case diary as well as statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 183 of BNSS it reflect that complainant is a married lady and there is matrimonial dispute with her husband.
The present applicant and the complainant were in relationship since 31.12.2022.

6. Considering the totality of the circumstances of the case, this Court deems it appropriate to enlarge the applicant on anticipatory bail, therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case,
the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that in the event of arrest, applicant-Abhinav Mishra shall be enlarged on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer for his appearance before him during the course of investigation or before the trial Court concerned during trial, as the case may be.
8. It is further directed that the applicant shall abide by all the conditions as enumerated under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C./482 (2) of BNSS.
